home.heading: Platform foundation
home.intro: The technical foundation is in place. Business modules are not yet implemented.

foundation.money: Money and percentage value objects with exact decimal arithmetic
foundation.schedule: Schedule date calculation with month-end clamping
foundation.errors: Single API error envelope and global exception handling
foundation.migrations: Flyway migrations with money and rate domains

system.heading: System status
system.unreachable: The backend is not reachable. Start it with: mvn spring-boot:run

login.heading: Sign in
login.intro: Your company key tells us which company's account to sign you into.
login.unreachable: The server is not reachable. Check your connection and try again.

inventory.heading: Inventory
inventory.intro: Units across every project. Sold and blocked units are hidden unless you ask for them.
inventory.priceInvalid: Enter an amount such as 2500000 or 2500000.00
inventory.loadFailed: The inventory could not be loaded.

holds.heading: Holds
holds.intro: Units held for a buyer. A hold keeps a unit off the market until it expires or is released.
holds.depositOptional: Optional. Leave empty if no deposit was taken.
holds.depositInvalid: Enter an amount such as 50000 or 50000.00
holds.placeFailed: The hold could not be placed.
holds.partyHint: A hold is for one customer or one lead.
holds.partiesUnavailable: Customers and leads could not be loaded.
holds.expiryNote: The hold expires after your company's standard period. You can extend it later.
holds.releaseExplain: The unit goes back on the market immediately. This is recorded against your name.
holds.loadFailed: Your holds could not be loaded.
holds.actionFailed: That did not work. Please try again.
holds.confirmHint: Confirming takes the unit off the market.
holds.confirmDenied: Only a manager or operations can confirm a hold.

deals.heading: Deal
deals.listIntro: Deals you can see. An agent sees their own, a branch manager their branch.
deals.listEmpty: No deals yet. Start one from a unit in Inventory.
deals.loadFailed: That deal could not be loaded.

value.heading: Value
value.grossIsFrozen: The gross value is the unit's list price, frozen when the deal was drafted. A later price change does not reach it.

discounts.heading: Discounts
discounts.eitherOr: A discount is either a percentage or a fixed amount. Percentages are taken against the gross value and are added, never compounded.
discounts.approvalRequired: This discount is above your company's threshold, so a manager must approve it before the deal can be activated.

plan.heading: Payment schedule
plan.none: No schedule yet. Choose a payment plan to generate one.
plan.noTemplates: No payment plans are offered for this unit's project yet.

schedule.doesNotBalance: This schedule totals {{total}} but the deal's net value is {{net}}. Regenerate it before activating.
schedule.expectedOnly: These are the amounts the customer is expected to pay. Payments received are recorded separately.

activation.heading: Activation
activation.activated: Deal activated. The unit is now sold.
activation.ready: Everything needed is in place. Activating sells the unit and makes the schedule live.
activation.needsSchedule: Generate a payment schedule before activating.
activation.scheduleStale: The schedule no longer matches the deal's net value. Regenerate it before activating.
activation.needsApproval: A manager must approve the discount before activating.
activation.liveUnitSold: This deal is live and its unit is sold.
activation.completionNote: Under brokered inventory completion is recorded by hand. Under own inventory it follows from the schedule being fully paid.

downPayment.prompt: Has the developer confirmed they received the down payment?
downPayment.noPaymentCreated: This records a confirmation, not a payment. The developer collects under this commercial model.

draft.title: Start a deal on {{code}}
draft.customersOnly: A deal is made with a customer. Convert a lead first if they are not one yet.
draft.grossFromListPrice: Gross value will be the list price, {{amount}} EGP, frozen onto the deal.
draft.convertsHold: This unit has a {{status}} hold. The deal will be linked to it.
draft.failed: The deal could not be started.
